generation.method: Offline macOS say, Albert voice at 150 words/minute; FFmpeg loudnorm and PCM conversion. No recordings, AI service, or network synthesis.
generation.reproducibility: Committed bytes and SHA-256 are authoritative. Regeneration is optional and may differ with OS voice/FFmpeg versions; browser tests never invoke TTS.

counting.purpose: Initial speech plumbing validation only; not a lesson scenario corpus.
